author: Nintendo of America
description:
Save your story in Escape from Ever After, available now on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/escape-from-ever-after-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01 

In this adventure RPG, your fairytale castle has been converted into a corporate office by Ever After Inc., and your fellow characters are in danger of being exploited for cheap labor! Join forces with your storybook coworkers to fight back against capitalism in a world where the rules are always changing.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
Scott Pilgrim EX releases on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch on March 3, 2026! 

Matthew Patel and Robot-01 enter the fray! Battle through space and time in Toronto as a variety of fan-favorite fighters. Finish off your foes with stylish combos, wacky weapons, and over-the-top specials. With up to four players in online or local co-op, share the action with your friends!
